title: A Message That Arrives Too Late
title_ja: 遅れて届くメッセージ
fact_notes: 人物・出来事・制度・任務は架空の教材例。実在の調査・統計・実証結果・宇宙運用基準や法令ではない。制作台帳は来歴確認用。

sentences.en: Imagine a future research station on a distant world, where communication with a control center on Earth involves a substantial delay because signals must travel across an enormous distance.
sentences.ja: 信号が極めて長い距離を移動するため地球の管制センターとの通信に大幅な遅延がある遠い世界の未来の研究基地を想像しよう。

sentences.en: The station is staffed by a small team responsible for carrying out scientific observations, maintaining equipment, and responding to unexpected changes in its surroundings.
sentences.ja: 基地には科学観測、機材管理、周囲の予期しない変化への対応を担う少人数のチームがいる。

sentences.en: Before the mission, the planners propose requiring the crew to request authorization from Earth whenever they need to modify an important scientific procedure.
sentences.ja: 任務前に計画者は重要な科学手順の変更が必要になるたび地球に許可を求めることを提案する。

sentences.en: Supporters of this requirement argue that specialists at the control center possess expertise that the crew cannot be expected to reproduce in every area of research.
sentences.ja: 賛成者は管制センターの専門家が乗員に全研究分野で再現するよう求められない専門知識を持つと主張する。

sentences.en: Other planners question whether waiting for instructions would be appropriate in situations where the significance of an observation could change before a response arrived.
sentences.ja: 他の計画者は応答が到着する前に観測の重要性が変化し得る状況で指示を待つことが適切か疑問を持つ。

sentences.en: The planners consider a hypothetical incident in which two instruments produce measurements that appear inconsistent with one another during a time-sensitive experiment.
sentences.ja: 計画者は時間制約のある実験で二つの機器が互いに矛盾するように見える測定値を出す仮想事例を考える。

sentences.en: If the crew immediately stops collecting data, it may lose an opportunity to record an unusual event that cannot easily be repeated at a later time.
sentences.ja: 乗員が直ちにデータ収集を止めれば後で容易に再現できない珍しい出来事を記録する機会を失うかもしれない。

sentences.en: Conversely, continuing the experiment without investigating the inconsistency could generate a large quantity of information whose scientific value would be difficult to establish.
sentences.ja: 反対に不一致を調べず実験を続けると科学的価値の確定が難しい大量の情報を生み得る。

sentences.en: The appropriate response depends partly on whether the disagreement reflects a known limitation of one instrument or a previously unrecognized feature of the phenomenon under observation.
sentences.ja: 適切な対応は不一致が機器の既知の限界か観測対象のこれまで認識されなかった特徴かにも左右される。

sentences.en: The incident illustrates why a comprehensive set of instructions prepared in advance may still fail to specify the best action for every combination of circumstances.
sentences.ja: この事例は事前に用意した包括的指示でもあらゆる状況の組み合わせに最善の行動を指定できない場合がある理由を示す。

sentences.en: Rather than choosing between unrestricted local authority and complete dependence on the control center, the planners identify several categories of decisions that require different levels of supervision.
sentences.ja: 無制限の現地権限と管制センターへの完全依存の二択でなく異なる監督水準を要する判断の分類を特定する。

sentences.en: They distinguish adjustments that can be reversed without substantial consequences from changes whose effects would be difficult to evaluate or undo after the procedure has been carried out.
sentences.ja: 大きな影響なく取り消せる調整と実施後に影響を評価したり取り消したりするのが難しい変更を区別する。

sentences.en: They also consider whether an action is intended to preserve an existing scientific opportunity or to introduce an entirely new objective that other groups have not had an opportunity to examine.
sentences.ja: 既存の科学機会を維持する行動か他の集団が検討する機会のなかった全く新しい目的の導入かも考慮する。

sentences.en: Within a clearly defined range of ordinary decisions, the crew could exercise discretion while documenting the observations and reasoning that prompted a change.
sentences.ja: 明確に定められた通常判断の範囲内で乗員は変更を促した観測と推論を記録しながら裁量を行使できる。

sentences.en: The control center would subsequently examine those records, not simply to determine whether the crew had followed a prescribed routine, but to improve the guidance available for future situations.
sentences.ja: 管制センターは後にその記録を調べ、単に規定手順の遵守を確認するだけでなく将来に利用できる指針を改善する。

sentences.en: A further problem arises when communication is eventually restored and specialists on Earth disagree with a decision that the crew made under considerable uncertainty.
sentences.ja: 通信が回復し地球の専門家が大きな不確実性のもとで乗員が行った判断に異議を唱えると別の問題が生じる。

sentences.en: The specialists may possess more detailed information about the equipment, yet they may not fully appreciate the practical constraints that existed during the incident itself.
sentences.ja: 専門家は機材の詳細情報を多く持つかもしれないが事例発生時の実際的制約を十分理解していないかもしれない。

sentences.en: The crew, in contrast, may have observed circumstances that were impossible to communicate completely in a brief report while lacking some of the technical knowledge necessary to interpret them.
sentences.ja: 対照的に乗員は短い報告で完全に伝えられない事情を観察した一方、解釈に必要な専門知識の一部を欠いていたかもしれない。

sentences.en: A useful review would therefore reconstruct the information available to each group at the relevant time before evaluating the adequacy of the original decision.
sentences.ja: 有益な見直しでは元の判断の妥当性を評価する前に各集団が当時利用できた情報を再構成する。

sentences.en: Such a review could identify limitations in communication or preparation without assuming that a disappointing outcome necessarily demonstrates that the crew exercised its authority irresponsibly.
sentences.ja: その見直しは期待外れの結果が乗員の無責任な権限行使を必ず示すと想定せず通信や準備の限界を特定できる。

sentences.en: The fictional example is not intended to establish appropriate operational procedures for any actual space mission, whose design would require extensive specialist assessment and independent verification.
sentences.ja: 架空の例は広範な専門評価と独立検証を要する実際の宇宙任務の適切な運用手順を確立することを目的としない。

sentences.en: Instead, it illustrates a broader problem that arises whenever people possessing different kinds of knowledge must cooperate under conditions that prevent immediate consultation.
sentences.ja: むしろ異なる知識を持つ人々が即時協議できない条件で協力しなければならないときに生じる広い問題を示す。

sentences.en: Centralizing authority may promote consistency and access to expertise, but the advantages of centralization can diminish when relevant information cannot reach the people responsible for making a decision in time.
sentences.ja: 権限集中は一貫性と専門知識へのアクセスを促し得るが関連情報が判断担当者に間に合わない場合その利点は減少し得る。

sentences.en: Distributing authority, on the other hand, requires careful attention to the limits of local discretion and to the procedures through which decisions can subsequently be examined and improved.
sentences.ja: 一方権限分散には現地裁量の限界と後で判断を検討・改善する手順への注意が必要だ。

sentences.en: The central challenge is consequently not to determine whether independence or supervision is inherently superior, but to create an arrangement in which responsibility corresponds to the information and resources that people can actually access when action becomes necessary.
sentences.ja: したがって主要課題は自立と監督のどちらが本質的に優れるか決めるのでなく行動が必要なとき実際に使える情報と資源に責任が対応する仕組みを作ることだ。

options: Signals must cross a huge distance.
The crew deliberately turns off all equipment.

questions.prompt: Why question advance authorization for every change?
options: A delayed response may arrive after circumstances change.
The crew will never need guidance.
The mission involves no scientific procedures.

questions.prompt: What dilemma arises from inconsistent readings?
options: All observations must be discarded in every case.
The crew can always repeat the event.
Stopping may lose an observation while continuing may produce questionable data.
questions.explanation_ja: 停止と継続の両方に問題。

questions.prompt: What determines an appropriate response in part?
options: The size of the control center.
What explains the disagreement between instruments.
The price of communication equipment alone.
By the crew's favorite research topics.
By factors such as reversibility and consequences.
By the length of reports alone.
By identical rules regardless of effects.
Allow later review and improvement of guidance.

questions.prompt: Why reconstruct information available at the time?
options: Every later judgment must be rejected.
Later reviewers may know different facts from those acting at the scene.

questions.prompt: What should a review avoid assuming?
options: A bad outcome necessarily proves irresponsible action.
questions.explanation_ja: 結果だけで断定しない。

options: Authority should match available information and resources while preserving review.
questions.explanation_ja: 責任と情報・資源の対応。

paraphrases.rewrite: They separate reversible adjustments from alterations with effects that are hard to assess or reverse.
